name: How much does door adjustment and repair usually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does door adjustment and repair usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on whether the job is a minor adjustment, a hardware replacement, or a more complex repair involving the frame or threshold. If you send photos first, a technician can often narrow the estimate before the visit and avoid surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor fixes cost less than frame or hardware repairs. Photos can help get a clearer estimate before scheduling.
